node: Sauces, oils, dressings, condiments, mayonnaise, butter blends, and seasonings
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-company universe for the restaurant flavor-input node. The strongest direct public mapping is Lancaster Colony/T. Marzetti because filings explicitly describe custom-formulated sauces and salad dressings sold into foodservice, plus licensed chain-linked sauces. McCormick and Kraft Heinz are included as reference leaders with broad flavor/condiment exposure and foodservice reach. B&G Foods is the underfollowed small-cap candidate: it has product-category overlap in oils, seasonings, hot sauces, vinegars, salad dressings and salsas, but the restaurant-chain/private-label linkage is weaker and needs verification. Private companies such as Ventura Foods, Golden State Foods, Ken's Foods and Mizkan appear highly relevant to the node but are not US-listed candidates; they should be used as competitive and customer/supplier context rather than investable names in this pass.
